meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 对设计按 Dieter Rams 十项原则逐条打分(0–3,每项附证据),给出新设计 / 改进 / 重做三种结论之一,并生成一份可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 交接提示词。结果写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录下的分数卡、结论等文件。
howto.when: 当你提到「audit this design」「design review」等说法,或要求对某个界面做评审、并希望引出后续计划时触发。常规 UI 代码评审、纯文案改动不归它管。

say.text: 审计这个页面,按 Rams 十项原则打分
say.note: 会先锁定审计范围,再分头收集证据

say.text: 这个设计该改进还是推倒重做?
设计还不存在,帮我给新设计出个计划
say.note: 跳过证据阶段,直接给新设计结论与提示词

howto.what_en: Scores a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles (0-3 each, with evidence), gives a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and emits a copy-pasteable /make-plan handoff prompt. Artifacts land in a DESIGN-IS-<date>/ folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design" or "design review", or ask for a Rams-based critique that should lead to a plan. Not for routine UI code reviews or pure copy edits.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles
say_en.note: Locks scope first, then fans out for evidence

say_en.text: Should this design be refined or redesigned?
say_en.note: Returns a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict with reasons

say_en.text: Nothing is designed yet — plan a new design
say_en.note: Skips evidence, goes straight to the NEW verdict and prompt
